name: Process AP batch scans with three-way match, fraud checks and human review in PaperOffice AI

parameters.content:
## AP inbox: batch scans to approved invoices

**Who it is for:** accounts payable teams and bookkeeping firms that scan stacks of orders, delivery notes and invoices and need a documented approval before payment.

**What it does:** [PaperOffice AI](https://paperoffice.ai/en/) splits the scan, reads every document and matches each invoice against the real order and delivery note. Fraud signals are flagged and **a human decides**. This workflow never releases a payment.

### How it works
1. **Upload scan** → **Start split** separates the documents; the job is polled every 10 s.
2. Each document is archived in the inbox workspace and read.
3. **Loop over invoices**: IBAN against earlier invoices, duplicates, three-way match (same scan first, then archive), order already billed.
4. A check report is stored on the invoice and the invoice goes to the HITL queue.
5. **Review decision** (signed webhook): approved → approved workspace, optional WORM lock; rejected → quarantine with legal hold.

### Set up (about 15 minutes)
1. Bearer credential with your PaperOffice AI token ([Account → API](https://app.paperoffice.ai/en/paperoffice-account/api)) in all PaperOffice nodes.
2. **Settings**: the three workspace IDs and the HITL agent UUID. **Archive settings**: approved and quarantine IDs again.
3. Copy the production URL of **Review decision** into the HITL agent; its signing secret into **Compute signature**. Then activate.

### Video walkthrough
@[youtube](gDwfCGvXyjo)

### Customize
Swap the form for an email or Drive trigger. Add Xero, QuickBooks or Slack after **Approved?**. No specific plan is required. Usage is billed to your PaperOffice AI account as usual. API reference: [llms.txt](https://api.paperoffice.ai/latest/docs/llms.txt)

## 1 · Split the scan
One PDF in, single documents out. The split runs as a background job and is polled until it is finished.

## 2 · Archive and read every document
Invoices, orders and delivery notes are stored in the inbox workspace and read with line items.

## 3 · Check each invoice
IBAN, duplicates, three-way match against the real documents and earlier billing. Anything unclear is a finding.

## 4 · Report and human review
The report is stored on the invoice; every invoice goes to the HITL queue. The form shows one line per invoice.

## 5 · Decision webhook
Signed by PaperOffice AI. Approved → approved workspace (optional WORM). Rejected → quarantine with legal hold.
